build_DETRsegm_model: build a DETRsegm segmentation model wrapping a DETR detector with mask prediction via MHAttentionMap and MaskHeadSmallConv
build_MaskHeadSmallConv_head: build a MaskHeadSmallConv convolutional head that predicts segmentation masks using FPN-style upsampling and group normalization
build_MHAttentionMap_module: build a MHAttentionMap 2D attention module that computes attention softmax weights between queries and key features
test_dice_loss: test the dice_loss function to compute DICE loss between predicted mask inputs and binary target masks
test_sigmoid_focal_loss: test the sigmoid_focal_loss function to compute focal loss with configurable alpha and gamma weighting factors
